description: Create anonymous one-off Stripe Checkout; no Pulse account or API key required. First read estimate_cost.analysis_options.checkout for admission minimum and billing guidance. Obtain explicit human approval to create the link and confirm a lawful basis for the audio; one rights confirmation can cover a requested batch/folder/project. Save job_id, payment_url and continuation.review_url privately; a lost Checkout link requires support, not a replacement purchase. Present payment_url and the upfront charged_display when returned for human review/payment. A reused link may omit charge fields; review its hosted amount rather than treating cost_display as the charge. Analysis begins automatically after payment; poll get_job_status with job_id. If estimate_pricing_changed is returned, get a fresh free estimate and new explicit approval. Never silently retry analysis or purchase. Below-admission quotes may offer minimum_charge_offer: show its upfront estimate and minimum final cost, then obtain explicit acceptance before passing accept_minimum_charge:true and max_upfront_amount_cents equal to the approved upfront ceiling. Never infer consent from rights confirmation. An exceeded cap needs fresh human review, not an automatic retry. If an existing Claude connector is missing accept_minimum_charge (boolean) or max_upfront_amount_cents (integer), refresh its tools list and start a fresh conversation using that same connector, preserving its URL/key/approval permissions and the original saved job/payment link. Stop if fields remain missing; never create a replacement purchase or new key for recovery. Two scoped existing-connector Claude Checkout workflows, including minimum-charge acceptance, were validated; anonymous initialization, OAuth, trial/banked workflows, other hosts and live cap rejection are not certified.

accept_minimum_charge.description: Optional. Set true only after explicit human acceptance of minimum_charge_offer.minimum_final_cost_usd and its estimated upfront payment. Rights confirmation alone is not spending approval.

attestation_confirmed.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has confirmed they have rights, permission, lawful access, or another legal basis to submit this audio, or the current user-requested batch/folder/project containing it, for analysis.

max_upfront_amount_cents.description: Optional approved upfront USD ceiling in whole cents; required for minimum-charge acceptance. The gateway rejects a higher charge before creating a purchase. Do not raise it without renewed human approval.

name: request_payment_link

continuation.description: Advisory saved-job recovery. URLs contain a private job reference. No provider read or settlement verification is performed.

deduped.description: True when an existing active Checkout link was reused.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the Checkout link expires.

job_id.description: Pulse job id for polling after payment.

payment_url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to present to the user.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry after changing state or waiting.
